facilityBenchmarks.name: General Office & Corporate Suite
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Based on JaniScope medium-density commercial office tasks (trash pull, high/low dusting, backpack vacuuming, damp mopping, and restroom sanitization).

facilityBenchmarks.name: Medical & Dental Clinic
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Applies a 1.35x terminal disinfection factor for EPA List N hospital-grade dwell times, color-coded microfiber cross-contamination control, and exam-room sink sanitization.

facilityBenchmarks.name: Post-Construction Cleanup
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Post-construction requires slow, multi-pass HEPA drywall dust extraction, adhesive/paint overspray removal, window track detailing, and fixture polishing (~500–800 sq ft/hr).

facilityBenchmarks.name: Retail Store & Showroom
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Sized for open-aisle hard floors with heavy scuffing, glass storefronts, fitting room mirrors, and checkout counter sanitization.

facilityBenchmarks.name: Church, Worship & School Campus
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Accounts for dense seating rows in sanctuaries/classrooms, nursery toy/surface sanitization, and post-event multi-stall restroom surges.

facilityBenchmarks.name: Gym & Fitness Studio
facilityBenchmarks.notes: Includes 1.25x antimicrobial disinfection factor for sweat/odor control, locker room showers, rubber/hardwood studio floors, and full-wall mirrors.
